# Philips N4520 Player v0.0.16

## Changes

- Recalibrates Sendspin PCM VU interpretation for normalized audio samples.
- Adds `sendspin_vu_calibration_db` so installations can tune the RMS dBFS to VU mapping without changing code.
- Adds `sendspin_vu_offset_ms` so the Sendspin VU display can be delayed or advanced relative to audible playback.
- Documents the Sendspin level format as decoded, normalized PCM rather than precomputed meter values.

## Notes

The default Sendspin calibration is now `22`, which maps approximately
`-22 dBFS RMS` to `0 VU`. Increase the value if the meters read too low, or
decrease it if the meters sit too high.

Use `sendspin_vu_offset_ms` when the needles do not line up with the audible
music. Positive values delay the VU display. Negative values apply frames as
soon as they are received, but true advance depends on Sendspin delivering
audio ahead of the actual speaker output.
